descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-21/S22, TC-25/S24b, TC-19/S23

Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S23 Native iOS/Android on the local stack: tap the badge, change it, background and reopen; camera scan lands Follow-up; a phone with a wrong date or no clock set shows the same badge

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U2 Every scanned patient defaults to Follow-up (Hospital census-photo scan and Nursing Home resident-list scan) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2)
  • U6 The day roll uses server time, not the device clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone shows the same badge and the same pre-selected template as any other device, and nev … (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Android: the debug build of main e02167f bundled for the local stack (scripts/android-lane.ts: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 on AVD rc_api36, or a USB phone with the same reverse). iOS: a local Xcode build of main pointed at the local stack. Second device: the web app on Vite 6473. …

When Tap the chart badge and pick each state in the native picker, background the app and reopen; photograph a printed census and a resident list; then set the phone's date one day back and set a patient and a resident to New Admission on the phone; …

Then The native picker offers the three states; the choice persists after reopening; every scanned patient is Follow-up; with the phone's clock wrong or unset, the phone and the web device show the same badge and Note Format pre-selection, and what the phone set still reads New Admission on the web device

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same as the S01/S02/S05 checkpoints, judged by a person. UAT 3.8 'Test with one device set to the wrong date' + TFA-92584 AC 8: on main the phone's day decides, so the clock cells are expected to Fail (known: TFA-92584 AC 8). 3.9: record the vision model

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (local debug build, or store build on dev); Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S23

Native iOS/Android on the local stack: tap the badge, change it, background and reopen; camera scan lands Follow-up; a phone with a wrong date or no clock set shows the same badge

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Judged 4/10 on Android: the chart badge's native picker lists New Admission / Follow-up / Consult (Hospital and Nursing Home), and Consult picked on the phone is kept after 10 s in the background and after force-closing and reopening the app (stored encType consult) - passed. Phone date one day behind: New Admission set on the phone shows New Admission / H&P (SNF admission) there, while the correctly set web device shows Follow-up / SOAP progress (SNF follow-up), and once the web device opened them the server row was rolled to Follow-up (encTypeDay 2026-10-15), so what the phone set does not read New Admission on the web: 6 cells fail in both contexts - known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8 (the expected Fail per the matrix). 'No clock set' cannot be set up on Android (the OS always keeps a time). Camera: the scan control opened Android's photo picker, not the camera (new, see EFS/S18), so photographing a printed census is not possible from the app on Android; the 'scanned patients land Follow-up' cell also needs the printed sheet and the live vision model (left). iOS half not run: the simulator cannot be tapped here without a permission prompt (no idb / Maestro / WebDriverAgent installed; the simulator-control and computer-use tools ask first), and the only booted simulator runs someone else's dev-pointed build (b8fb762), which was left alone. A separate prompt-free smoke on a new simulator (dvc-tc24-s24-ios-*) showed the iOS build on the local stack opening and listing patients.

Product issue: A physician whose phone date is a day behind sets a patient or resident to New Admission; a correctly set device shows Follow-up with the follow-up template pre-selected, and opening it there rolls the stored status to Follow-up (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 19 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14: dictation by microphone or speaker, iOS and Android are set aside).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
